checklist: shell pipes (bash | coreutils)
env sets variable for child
nice runs a child
nohup runs a child
exec keeps the pid: env/nice bash -c 'echo $PPID' is the outer bash's $$
timeout 1 sleep 5 → 124 after ~1 s; timeout 5 true → 0; exit status passes through
timeout -s KILL 1 sleep 5 → 137; --preserve-status → 143; -k 1 on a TERM-ignoring command → 137
timeout kills the command's whole process group (background child gone)
timeout of a missing command → 127; bad duration → 125
hostname prints the same as uname -n; hostname NAME → Operation not permitted

cert/users.mjs (9.12.0-5, H1 homescoop#207, slicc-kernel >= 1.44.0): as root id = 'uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)', id -un/whoami/logname root, id -G 0, groups root, groups cone 'cone : cone users'; as kernel.users.add({name:'cone'}) id = 'uid=1000(cone) gid=1000(cone) groups=1000(cone),100(users)', id -G '1000 100', whoami/logname cone; a file cone creates in ~ shows 'cone cone' in ls -l and stat %U:%G. Needs shims/slicc (process credentials, setgrent/getgrent) and build-gnu-cli.sh linking slicc_pwd's --wrap and ac_cv_func_getgroups_works=yes. File owners are the kernel's (1.44.0: uid 1000 for every file), so root's files are not checked

rdev (9.12.0-6, scripts/emsdk-patches/statx-rdev.patch, homescoop#324): stat -c '%t:%T' on /dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/full and /dev/tty gives the kernel's 1:3, 1:5, 1:7, 5:0; ls -l /dev/null shows '1, 3' on each of 3 runs; a regular file is 0:0. 9.12.0-5: /dev/null 0:0, ls -l majors from uninitialised stack

glue-mode (9.12.0-6, scripts/command-modes.mjs): bin/coreutils (the Emscripten glue) and bin/coreutils.wasm are 0755, as installed with the tarball's modes (the harness's kernel.chmod); run by path as kernel user cone under users enforce, bin/coreutils --version prints coreutils (GNU coreutils) 9.12. 9.12.0-5 shipped the glue 0644: 'Permission denied', rc 126

linkat (9.12.0-6, slicc_libc_gaps.c + slicc-linkat.js, slicc-kernel#563): coreutils.wasm imports env.__syscall_linkat; on the cert kernel (1.100.4, the wrapper since 1.90.0, slicc-kernel#568) ln, ln -f and cp -l in a tmpfs mount make real hard links (the files share the inode, nlink 2), the OPFS root is EMLINK and tmpfs → root EXDEV; on a kernel without the wrapper (1.88.0, see extra_kernels) they are 'Too many links' (EMLINK) as before. 9.12.0-5: no import (libc's weak stub answered EMLINK inside the wasm, so no kernel could link)

cert/uname.mjs (9.12.0-7, shims/slicc __syscall_uname, homescoop#373 / slicc-kernel#625; homescoop#358 prefix map; homescoop#425): coreutils.wasm imports env.__syscall_uname and names no emsdk cache directory (its emsdk paths are /emsdk/...). On a kernel that answers the import (slicc-kernel >= 1.98.0, read from /proc/version; the cert kernel 1.100.4): uname -s is Linux = /proc/sys/kernel/ostype, -r = /proc/sys/kernel/osrelease = /proc/version's release, -v = /proc/version's version (#1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC), -n = hostname (and /proc/sys/kernel/hostname when the kernel has it; 1.100.4 doesn't), -m wasm32, -o Emscripten (coreutils' configure-time host OS, not a utsname field), and uname -a is exactly those six joined by spaces, printable ASCII only (every field NUL-terminated within its 65 bytes). A kernel >= 1.98.0 on which uname -s is not Linux fails. On an older kernel: exactly Emscripten 4.0.23 #1 wasm32, as before. 9.12.0-6: no import, /home/runner/.cache/emsdk/0.4.0 paths; on 1.100.4 its uname -s is Emscripten (NEGATIVE.md); from 9.12.0-10 coreutils.wasm carries no DWARF at all (homescoop#908), so the /emsdk paths the map left in it are gone too

cert/symloop.mjs (9.12.0-8, scripts/emsdk-patches/libfs-symloop.patch, homescoop#461): chains of 39 and 40 symlinks (/c/l0 → … → /f) resolve for cat, stat -L and readlink -f, the 41st follow is ELOOP ('Symbolic link loop', rc 1), and a directory link plus 39 resolves from a relative path, as on Linux (MAXSYMLINKS 40) and slicc-kernel's own walks (slicc-kernel#700). 9.12.0-7: the 40-link chain is ELOOP (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/spawnp-path.mjs (9.12.0-11, shims/slicc/slicc_spawn.c posix_spawnp PATH search, slicc-kernel#1165), users=enforce as cone: with /tmp/hs1165/dbin then /tmp/hs1165/pbin first on PATH, timeout 5 hs1165script (a #!/bin/sh script in pbin; dbin/hs1165script is a directory, which passes access(X_OK) and is skipped, as execvp does) runs it (rc 0, path-ran); timeout 5 ./rel/script runs; timeout 5 seq 2 (a catalog command) prints 1 and 2; a mode-644 script on PATH is 126 'Permission denied'; a name only a directory on PATH matches (dbin/hs1165dironly) is 126 'Permission denied'; a missing name is 127 'No such file or directory'. 9.12.0-10: posix_spawnp was posix_spawn, so the bare name reached the kernel's catalog only and the PATH script was 127 (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/env-tz.mjs (9.12.0-12, homescoop#612, homescoop#535): env -i FOO=1 env has FOO=1 and none of Emscripten's defaults (USER/LOGNAME=web_user, PATH=/, HOME=/home/web_user, PWD=/, _, LANG; packages/coreutils/slicc-env.js), env -u HOME leaves no HOME, env -i HOME=/root keeps it; date honours TZ (packages/coreutils/slicc_tz.c, ahead of Emscripten's tzset/localtime_r/mktime): date -u -d @0 is 'Thu Jan  1 00:00:00 UTC 1970', UTC0 → UTC+0000, JST-9 → 09JST, EST5EDT → EST-0500 at @0 and EDT-0400 at @1720000000, <+0330>-3:30, mktime in EST5EDT (2026-07-01 12:00 → 1782921600, 2026-01-15 12:00 → 1768496400), America/New_York → EST -0500, Europe/Berlin → +0200 11, an unknown or empty TZ → UTC; touch -d reads its time in TZ; since 9.12.0-15 (homescoop#1626) an unset TZ (env -u TZ) is UTC named UTC whatever the browser's zone: date -d @0 is 'Thu Jan  1 00:00:00 UTC 1970', +%Z%z UTC+0000, @1720000000 +%H%Z 09UTC, mktime '1970-01-02 00:00' → 86400, touch -d 10:00 reads back 10:00 in UTC0; 9.12.0-14 prints UTC-0000 on a UTC browser and the browser's local time elsewhere (NEGATIVE.md). 9.12.0-11 fails 20 of its 38 assertions (NEGATIVE.md); since 9.12.0-14 (homescoop#1417) %Z for an IANA zone is the tz database's abbreviation, from a table in slicc_tz.c by zone, UTC offset and daylight saving (the offset is above the lowest one in both the year before and the year after), else Intl's en-US name, else the number, and never letters where tzdata has a number (Europe/Kaliningrad 2011-07 and 2012-01 +03, Asia/Famagusta 2017-07 +03, Kaliningrad 2024 EET): JST, GMT and BST (London), GMT and IST (Dublin), CET/CEST, MSK, AEST/AEDT, NZDT, IST (Kolkata), CST (Shanghai), SAST, GMT (Abidjan, Etc/GMT), HDT (Adak), NST, PDT, UTC, and +04 (Dubai), +0545 (Kathmandu), -03 (Sao_Paulo), +09 (Etc/GMT-9) where it has none; 9.12.0-13 prints +09, +00, +10 and the like (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/nice.mjs (9.12.0-14, homescoop#863, packages/coreutils/slicc_nice.c + printenv-slicc-nice.patch), as root and as cone: nice prints 0, nice -n 0 nice 0, nice -n 5 nice 5, nice nice 10, nice -n 5 nice -n 3 nice 8, nice -n 40 nice 19, nice -n 5 bash -c 'nice; nice -n 2 nice' 5 and 7 (children inherit it through bash), nice -n 5 true/false keep rc 0/1, env -i nice -n 4 nice 4, SLICC_NICE=5abc and SLICC_NICE= nice 0, SLICC_NICE=100 nice 19, SLICC_NICE=-100 nice -20, SLICC_NICE=7 nice 7 (garbage is 0, out of range clamped), all with empty stderr; nice -n -1 nice and nice -n 5 nice -n -2 nice: root gets -1 and 3, cone gets 'nice: cannot set niceness: …' once each and the command still runs (0, rc 0, 5). 9.12.0-13: every niceness is 20 and every nice -n warns (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/env-i.mjs (9.12.0-14, homescoop#612, packages/coreutils/slicc-env.js and the identical shims/slicc/slicc-env.js from #1491, both linked), as root and as cone: env -i env, env -i FOO=1 env, and the same through timeout 5, nohup and nice, print exactly nothing / FOO=1 (a HOSTNAME from the kernel aside; 1.100.4 sets one, 1.143.5 doesn't) with nothing on stderr; env -i env true, env -i timeout 5 true and env -i nice true find true without a PATH, rc 0. 9.12.0-11 has Emscripten's web_user defaults; 9.12.0-13 passes every row but the nice ones, which warn 'cannot set niceness' (NEGATIVE.md)
